text: This report addresses an appeal respecting a Sign Variance application (the “Sign Variance”). The Sign Variance contains one first party electronic ground sign, displaying both static copy and electronic moving copy (the "Proposed Sign"), which would be located on the north frontage of the property municipally known as 427 Bloor Street West (the “Subject Premises”). The Proposed Sign would have two sign faces, in a “v-shaped” configuration, each of the sign faces are proposed to measure 2.53 metres vertically by 1.93 metres horizontally, and height of 3.66 metres. The Proposed Sign would identify and provide information for Trinity - Saint Paul’s Centre located on the Subject Premises. A Sign variance was originally applied by Jordan’s Sign Permits on behalf of Steel Art Sign Corp (collectively known as the "Applicant"), as authorized by Trinity Saint Paul’s United Church (the “Owner”).…

The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Granted the variances to 694-15.A, 694-20.I and 694-21.D of Chapter 694, Signs, General, with respect of one electronic ground sign (the “Proposed Sign”), each subject to multiple conditions, as required to allow for the issuance of a permit respecting the erection and display of the Proposed Sign proposed to be located on the premises municipally known as 427 Bloor Street West, as described in detail in Attachment 5 to the report (May 24, 2024) from the Manager, Citywide Priorities, Toronto Building, with the following amendments: a. Variance number 3 as noted in the Variances listed in Attachment 5 to the report (May 24, 2024) from the Manager, Citywide Priorities, Toronto Building, be deleted; and, b.
